name: Necromancer Champions keep the client's own 5 minute cooldown and share 3 minutes (#7516)
contract: Spell.dbc (client patch-T.MPQ, identical to the server Spell.dbc) gives Gravebound 805049, Spellbound 807811 and Icebound 807813 Category 55, RecoveryTime 300000 ms and CategoryRecoveryTime 180000 ms, so the cast Champion is on a 5 minute cooldown and the other Champions on the 3 minute shared cooldown that the tooltip names ('Shares a $?s301198[2min][3min] cooldown with other Champion spells'). Game of Bones 301198 is a SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN flat -60000 ms on family 29 mask (0, 0, 0x800000), which Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies to both values: 240000 ms on the cast Champion and 120000 ms shared. A control Necromancer and one with Game of Bones each summon a Gravebound Champion once; the cast Champion must carry the 5 (4) minute cooldown, the other Champions the 3 (2) minute shared cooldown.
